posts.text: I'm excited to share I've started as a Software Developer Intern at IBM. I'm looking forward to learning new skills and expanding my network over the course of my 12 month term.

This summer, I had the privilege of working at RBC in their Amplify program, and it was amazing. Alongside Mallory Bond, Meet Patel, and Isabella Zhong, I built Seal, a patent-pending control evidence validation platform. Seal is engineered to make the control validation process simple, clean, and efficient through clever use of AI and automation. We explored how AI can be integrated into a tricky and manual process - such as control validation - and walked away with both stellar results and new

I'm thrilled to share I've started as a software developer at RBC Amplify. This is an exciting opportunity. I'm looking forward to my growth over the summer and innovating with RBC. Thank you to all the amazing people I've met at RBC. #RBCAmplify

Since my third year is coming to a start, I'd like to share what I've been doing over the summer! I've been tremendously fortunate to come back as a co-op at TELUS. During my time over the summer, I worked on a project to automate the entry of timesheets. One of my proudest achievements is that this project will be in use to automate the timesheets of over 3600 people! Since my first term at TELUS also dealt with automation and scripting, I was able to put those skills to use alongside brand-new

This past weekend, I participated - and won an award - at Hack Western 11 alongside my teammates Dhir Pathak, Mahdi Raza Khunt, and Fatih Nararya Rashadyfa. My team and I are proud that we walked away with the Best Video Game Hack award! We spent the competition creating a suite of games to be controlled with an EEG headset. I am incredibly grateful to have had an amazing co-op experience at TELUS this summer! During my time at TELUS, I worked on a variety of projects. From managing TELUS' GitHub pages to checking the compatibility of my team's software, I learned so much in just four months. One of my proudest moments was automating a suite of test cases for my team's software. The switch from testing manually to automatically increased efficiency by over 96%!
